items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was a rhythm-and-blues thing with Charlie Singleton’s band. I wasn’t – didn’t play any solos on it. I played baritone on that.

ctx.x: I understand that although people say that Dig was the first thing you recorded, you actually did something while you were there. Is that with the Charlie Singleton, Camel Walkin’?

No, that was another one. That was the first record that I ever made, period. That was a rhythm-and-blues thing with Charlie Singleton’s band. I wasn’t – didn’t play any solos on it. I played baritone on that.
